ov: السحر العملي 2 (الإنجليزية: Practical Magic 2) هو فلم فنتازيا رومانسي أمريكي قادم، أخرجته سوزان بيير عن سيناريو كتبه أكيفا جولدسمان، وجورجيا بريتشيت، وكيلي مارسيل، مقتبس من رواية كتاب السحر (الإنجليزية: The Book of Magic) الصادرة عام 2021 للكاتبة أليس هوفمان. وهو تتمة لفلم السحر العملي الصادر عام 1998. وتعود ساندرا بولوك، ونيكول كيدمان، وديان ويست، وستوكارد تشانينج لتجسيد أدوارهن من الفلم السابق، وينضم إليهن جوي كينج، ولي بيس، ومايسي وليمز، وشولو ماريدونيا، وسولي ماكلويد. ومن المقرر طرح الفلم في الولايات المتحدة في 11 سبتمبر 2026.
plotEn:
A few years after the events of the first film, in Massachusetts, the Owens family is struck by tragedy once again by the curse cast by their ancestor, Maria Owens: that any man who loves an Owens woman meets tragedy. Sisters Sally and Gillian believe that they broke the curse, but Sally's second husband, Gary Hallet, dies soon after they are married. Grief-stricken, Sally rejects her magic and casts a final spell to make her daughters, Kylie and Antonia, forget about magic, hoping the curse will never affect them.
Years later, Sally and Gillian's aunt Jet follows a raven omen to the Book of Raven, which contains instructions to break Maria's curse, but crucial pages are sealed. Jet, knowing she will die soon, leaves a note with the book for her sister Frances to continue her work. Kylie and Antonia return home for Jet's birthday, which they celebrate with Sally, Gillian, and the aunts. 
After Jet dies, the family holds a wake at the house. There, Sally and Gillian meet Kylie's boyfriend, Gideon. Kylie tells him she loves him, and the next morning he is hit by a car and left in a coma.
Kylie confronts Sally about the rumors that she and Antonia grew up knowing about an Owens curse. Sally, pressed by Gillian, admits that she hid their magical heritage, leaving them unprepared. Kylie, angered, steals the Book of Raven, hoping to find a way to save Gideon.
